subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should this umbrella remain open as the coordination tracker while maintainers split the remaining auth, installer/runtime, final-turn, and context-hygiene work into focused owned items?
rationale: The remaining work crosses security policy, setup/update behavior, provider auth migration, runtime packaging, and session-state semantics, and the repository policy requires maintainer intent before changing those boundaries.

options.title: Keep and split focused work
options.body: Leave this issue open as coordination, and route each remaining subproblem to focused issues or PRs with security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Close in favor of narrower items
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers explicitly decide the linked narrower issues fully preserve all remaining context.

options.title: Sponsor one broad stabilization project
options.body: Treat this as a single maintainer-owned project, accepting the broader coordination and validation cost instead of smaller owner-scoped work.

recommendation.title: Keep and split focused work
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as coordination, and route each remaining subproblem to focused issues or PRs with security and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is connected to the current central code paths and recent related maintainer comments across final-turn, dashboard, and auth migration surfaces.
